## What is Baileys?

Baileys is a WebSocket-based library that lets you interact with WhatsApp Web without a browser. It connects as a linked device, so you can build bots, automation tools, and integrations in Node.js.

This package is a customized fork of [WhiskeySockets/Baileys](https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/Baileys), maintained by Ran-Dev.

## Features

- Send and receive text, images, video, audio, documents, and stickers
- Group, community, and channel (newsletter) management
- Pairing code and QR login
- Multi-device support
- Written in TypeScript, with full type definitions
- Custom startup banner

## Tech Stack

| Language / Runtime | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| TypeScript | Main source code |
| JavaScript | Compiled output (ESM) |
| Node.js | Runtime environment |

## Installation

npm install @randev404/baileys
